description: This file contains scripts for managing release notes, changelog generation, and git commit analysis for a project, including functions to fetch git data, format release notes, and handle contributors.

methods.name: gitCommitsSince
methods.description: Fetches commit hashes since a given git tag.

methods.name: gitCommitsFor
methods.description: Fetches commit hashes for a specific file path.

methods.name: gitCommitDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of a specific commit.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches release plan, commits, contributors, and change data for a given tag.

methods.name: formatPackagesChanged
methods.description: Formats a list of updated packages into a changelog section.

methods.name: formatChange
methods.description: Formats a change entry for changelog.

methods.name: formatLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link for a pull request.

methods.name: sortByCommit
methods.description: Sorts change entries by commit hash.

methods.name: generateGitHubReleaseText
methods.description: Generates release notes and updates contributors list based on previous tag.
